# shelly_auth (Resource)

Sets the password of a Shelly device (HTTP digest authentication, user `admin`). When you delete this resource, the provider turns authentication off on the device. To manage other resources on a device with a password, set the provider `password` or the resource `device_password` to the same value.

To change the password, change it here and in the provider (or `device_password`) together, then run `terraform apply -refresh=false` one time. A refresh before the apply fails, because the device still has the old password.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "shelly_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Set the password on the device. Use the same value as the provider
# "password", so that the other resources can connect to the device.
resource "shelly_auth" "living_room" {
  ip       = "192.168.1.100"
  password = var.shelly_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IP address of the Shelly device.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The device password. Terraform keeps it in the state as a sensitive value.

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (String) The device ID. Shelly uses it as the digest realm.
